name: Veil of Mist
storyline:
Death has come… but the journey isn’t over.
Instead of emptiness, you find yourself in an unknown space-partly familiar, yet twisted and unstable. Rooms shift their shape, everyday objects behave unpredictably, and paths can suddenly close or open in unexpected directions. Somewhere nearby, something lurks that you’d better avoid. It sees everything and reacts to the slightest movement. You’ll explore, encounter unexplainable phenomena, uncover hidden mechanisms, and face challenges that demand your full attention. The only question remains-where exactly have you ended up after death? And what comes next?
summary: Veil of Mist is a first-person atmospheric horror adventure set in a shifting, logic-defying afterlife. Stay hidden from a deadly, perceptive entity, explore an ever-changing world, piece together fragmented memories, and face moral choices that shape your fate.
